title: LFM3 · 1.7B · Q4
format: Publisher QAD Q4_0 GGUF; mixed integer quantization; no local conversion.
source_authorization: User requested compact official LFM3 browser trials.

runtime_source.change: Official upstream LFM3 support PR31252; no weight conversion.

execution: Visiting browser; pinned source Wllama requests all supported GPU layers first, with explicit memory-allocation fallback to hybrid/CPU. Static Swarm and Playwright pinned sds-01. Actual per-node placement unmeasured; JS sampling/CPU work allowed. No phone qualification.

publisher_sampling.smoke_difference: Greedy temperature 0 for comparability; top_k=50, top_p=0.8, min_p=0, seed=42. Shared sampling helper does not send a repetition-penalty override; runtime default is not independently measured.

finding_summary: Passed actual combined-page READY, hidden-code Pi read/result, ordered skill-before-note exact report, image rejection and unload. Five-entry LFM3 landing UI/link also passed. Native reasoning is separated; greedy decoding effective temperature0.
thinking_interpretation: Thinking off is requested at load and per-generation; source-level kwargs forwarding verified. Model emitted reasoning-like prefixes despite this request. LFM3 transport separates that prefix from answer text; clean display does not prove nonreasoning computation.
limitations: Verified desktop text, native Pi tools and progressive skills. Reasoning is separated from the answer; 4,096-token tested context. Mobile unverified.
